reason: The finding holds on value and on feasibility. (1) It is a dummy, not a submission, so R2-R5 and R8 do not apply, and the night standing OK covers dummies. Only the S3 submit of the twin needs the user's OK on AMENDMENT f2 (W17). (2) The build is current. A rebuild of exp58n from git archive HEAD (ec8cd86) in scratch reproduces the committed notebook: sha 55038fd6... == experiments/exp58n_x138_safe_lowref (14c339e). (3) The twin is a strict subset of the dummy-gated K2 code. Of its 12 code cells, 10 are byte-equal to K2 cells. Cell 0 only drops the DIVINS_* lines. Cell 5 = K2 cell 7 minus the divinsert block (removals only). The DivNet helper cells are gone. Versus exp56, only cells 0/4/5 differ. Crash risk is therefore low, but this exact code path has never run, so a dummy is the only R7 proof. Byte-identical-when-off is moot because nothing new is added. (4) Timing: the twin cannot be submitted before S3 (~07-09 UTC 26 Sep, after the morning OK), so a dummy pushed now or at 00:05 would be ready in time either way. The real argument for NOW is quota. Before the expected but unconfirmed Saturday 00:00 reset, this week's remaining GPU time is use-it-or-lose-it. Pushing now costs nothing if the reset comes and the same as later if it does not. Nothing else needs the GPU before 00:00: K3/K3b wait on T9, and forkblob is closed. (5) The priority order is right. With no reset: twin + K3 + K3b ~2.25 GPU-h plus L6 ~4 h is more than the ~5-6 h left, so L6 goes first. Minor corrections: the quota left is more likely ~5.3-6.2 h than 4-5 (21:13 at 18:10, and part of shard A ran before 18:10). The dummy has zero GT divisions (PC2-09), so it proves plumbing only, which is all the twin needs. dummy_gates.py has no twin gate yet (PC2-01), but that blocks the gate reading, not the push.
fix: Push experiments/exp58n_x138_safe_lowref as-is now (sha 55038fd6...; python -m kaggle kernels push -p experiments/exp58n_x138_safe_lowref, run by the main session, not a submit). Before pushing, make sure no other GPU session is running, to avoid the concurrent-session limit. When it returns, apply the twin gate (PC2-01 / AMENDMENT f2). (a) Node rows with the id column stripped == the K2 dummy (exp58) on every clip. (b) edges(K2) - edges(twin) only at K2's DIVINS inserted/steal forks. (c) LOWDET and 'LOWREFINE <clip>: refined R of N' lines == K2 per clip. (d) No DIVINS lines at all. (e) No DEADLINE / REPAIR FAILED / LOWREFINE FAILED lines. (f) Kernel time <= K2 dummy (no DivNet load). At ~00:05 UTC check Settings for the GPU quota. With no reset, spend the ~5 h left on K3 then K3b dummies (only if their T9 gates pass) and drop L6. Record W06 (hidden reruns do not use the quota) and the reset result in CONTEXT. The twin submit in S3 still requires the user's explicit OK on f2; without it F2 stays exp52 and the dummy was a cheap unused option.
